senses.gloss:
1. लू cl. 9. P. Ā. (Dhātup. xxxi, 13) लुना॑ति, लुनीते (Ved. also लुनोति pf. लुलाव, Kathās.; 2. sg. लुलविथ, Pāṇ. vi, 1, 196, Sch.; 2. pl. लुलुविध्वे or ˚विढ्वे, ib. viii, 3, 79, Sch.; aor. अलावीत्, अलविष्ट Gr.; fut. लविता, लविष्यति, ˚ते, ib.; inf. लवितुम्, ib.; ind.p. लूत्वा, ib.; -लावम्, Kāv.),
to cut, sever, divide, pluck, reap, gather, TBr. &c. &c.;
to cut off, destroy, annihilate, Kāv.; Rājat. :
Pass. लूयते (aor. अलावि), to be cut Gr.:
Caus. लावयति (aor. अलीलवत्, ˚वत), to cause to cut Gr.:
Desid. of Caus. लिलावयिषति, ib. :
Desid. लुलूषति, ˚ते, ib. :
Intens. लोलूयते, लोलोति, ib. :
Desid. of Intens. लोलूयिषते (ind.p. ˚यम्), ib.
लू [cf. Gk. λύω; Lat. so-luo, solvo; Goth. fra-liusan; Germ. vir-lisosan, ver-lieren; Angl.Sax. for-leósan; Eng. lose.]
2. लू mfn. cutting, dividing &c., Pāṇ. vi, 4, 83, Sch. (cf. एक-लू).
